authority: Article XIX (never optimize for the gate; optimize for truth) — pre-registration of all numerical parameters BEFORE C2-Y-R1 experiment runs. Any parameter change after results are known is a constitutional violation.
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (parameters frozen before evidence is generated)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim (cannot tune parameters post-hoc)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (cannot adjust parameters to make C2-Y pass)
Article XXVII — no threshold invention (every numerical value has explicit source)
Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism (baseline reproduction failure is implementation failure, not candidate failure)
purpose: Round 156 specified the C2-Y-R1 experiment DESIGN (UISB baseline, cohort stratification, measurement availability, compute budget, FA constraint, primary endpoint, decision rule). Round 157 specifies the NUMERICAL PARAMETERS that will be used in execution. These parameters are now FROZEN. Any change requires a V2 pre-registration with explicit rationale.
hash_of_this_file: TO_BE_COMPUTED_AFTER_WRITE (will be recorded in ROUND157_ARTIFACT_HASH_PINS_V2 if needed)

UISB_baseline_A_VIEshunt_style_controlle.source: PMID 40087797 (VIEshunt, ETH Zurich / University Hospital Zurich, 2025) — Figure 4-5 ICP error response to CSF bolus perturbation

proportional_gain_Kp.source: Tuned to reproduce VIEshunt-published ICP error response (Figure 4 of PMID 40087797). If reproduction underperforms published by >20%, baseline is INCOMPLETE (Article XXIX).
proportional_gain_Kp.uncertainty: MEDIUM — exact VIEshunt gain not published; inferred from response shape
proportional_gain_Kp.if_reproduction_fails_at_Kp_0_15: Try Kp in {0.10, 0.12, 0.18, 0.20} BEFORE any C2-Y run. If NONE of these reproduce VIEshunt response within 20%, baseline implementation is INCOMPLETE; experiment BLOCKED.

integral_gain_Ki.source: Tuned to reproduce VIEshunt steady-state ICP recovery (Figure 5 of PMID 40087797)

posture_dependent_reference.source: Standard neurophysiological values; VIEshunt uses posture-dependent reference per PMID 40087797
posture_dependent_reference.uncertainty: LOW — these are well-established clinical values

noise_std_mmHg.source: Estimated from Nature 2026 ICP monitor published figures; low/medium/high span realistic chronic implant sensor noise range
noise_std_mmHg.uncertainty: MEDIUM — Nature 2026 published figures are graphical, not numerical

ICP_sensor_model.drift_source: Realistic for chronic implantable pressure sensor (based on Codman ICP Express published drift spec of <1 mmHg/day)

CSF_bolus_perturbation.timing: Random within ±2h of scheduled perturbation time

UISB_baseline_C_Codman_threshold_alarm_p.source: FDA 510(k) database + marketed products (Codman ICP Express, Medtronic Codman, Integra Neuroscience)
UISB_baseline_C_Codman_threshold_alarm_p.alarm_logic: Trigger if ICP > threshold for > 30 seconds (debounce)
UISB_baseline_C_Codman_threshold_alarm_p.operating_point_selection: Threshold tuned on training cohort to achieve exactly 1 false alarm per patient-month (per FA constraint in C2_Y_REBUILT_BASELINE_V1.json)
UISB_baseline_C_Codman_threshold_alarm_p.threshold_uncertainty: LOW — these are clinically standard values

disease_progression_model.step_duration_hours: uniform(6, 72) per step, randomized per patient
disease_progression_model.clinical_failure_definition: ICP > 25 mmHg sustained > 1 hour OR neurological symptom score > threshold (per standardized hydrocephalus symptom inventory)

virtual_cohort_parameters.random_seed_source: Fixed seed for reproducibility. Article IX (certification is observational) — the seed is recorded; any re-run with the same seed must produce the same cohort.

primary_endpoint_parameters.FPR_target_source: EMPIRICAL_THRESHOLD_PROVENANCE_V1.json — TRANSFERRED from cardiac alarm fatigue literature (Sendelbach & Halm 2015)
primary_endpoint_parameters.lead_time_window_source: Maximum plausible lead time — if C2-Y predicts failure >72h in advance, the prediction is not clinically actionable (patient may not yet be deteriorating)
primary_endpoint_parameters.operating_point_selection_method: Each arm's alert threshold is tuned on TRAINING cohort (60% of patients) to achieve exactly 1 FA/patient-month. Threshold is then frozen and applied to TEST cohort (40% of patients). No post-hoc threshold adjustment (Article XIX).

computational_budget.budget_monitoring: Computational cost logged per arm per hour. Exceeding budget is a CI failure.
computational_budget.rationale: Real shunt implants are battery-powered. A predictor requiring a GPU is not clinically practical.

statistical_analysis_plan.primary_analysis: Per-arm median lead time at FPR=1/month, with 95% confidence interval via bootstrap (n=1000 resamples)
statistical_analysis_plan.secondary_analysis: Per-arm failure-mode classification accuracy with 95% CI
statistical_analysis_plan.multiple_testing_correction: Bonferroni across 5 failure modes — adjusted alpha = 0.01 per mode
statistical_analysis_plan.per_protocol_vs_intent_to_treat: Per-protocol analysis only (no dropouts in virtual cohort)
statistical_analysis_plan.missing_data_handling: No missing data in virtual cohort; if any patient fails to complete the simulation, that patient is excluded with explicit rationale

FROZEN_artifacts_chain.preregistration_THIS_FILE: C2_Y_R1_PREREGISTRATION_V1.json (this file, hash to be recorded after write)

post_execution_procedure.step_1: Run experiment with FROZEN parameters above
post_execution_procedure.step_2: Record results in C2_Y_R1_RESULTS_V1.json with full provenance (random seed, parameter values, output data hashes)
post_execution_procedure.step_4: If WIN: proceed to C2-Y-R2 (independent reproduction via external solver — Article XXVIII)
post_execution_procedure.step_5: If KILL: add C2-Y to cemetery with explicit rationale; update discovery queue
post_execution_procedure.step_6: If INCONCLUSIVE: tighten experiment design OR public KILL (Article XXXIII — no irreversible action on unresolved evidence, but no permanent limbo either)

what_is_FORBIDDEN_after_results_are_know: Changing Kp, Ki, threshold levels, cohort size, random seed, or any other parameter (Article XIX)
Re-running with different parameters and reporting only the best result (Article XIX — multiple testing without correction)
Excluding specific patients or failure modes from the analysis (Article XXXII — must report strongest alternative explanation, including modes where C2-Y failed)
Adding post-hoc secondary endpoints and presenting them as primary (Article XXVIII — silent semantic promotion)

honest_disclosure.what_is_strong: Every numerical parameter is now frozen with explicit source. The FROZEN_artifacts_chain links this pre-registration to the hash-pinned Round 156 artifacts. Any post-hoc change is detectable via hash mismatch.
what_is_still_weak: The Kp=0.15 value is itself MODEL_DERIVED (inferred from VIEshunt-published response shape, not directly published). The sensitivity_range_to_test [0.10, 0.20] is the pre-registered range — but if NONE of these values reproduce VIEshunt response, we must either (a) acknowledge baseline reproduction failure and BLOCK, or (b) expand the range with V2 pre-registration. Option (b) is allowed only BEFORE results are known.
The random seed (42) is arbitrary. Different seeds may give different results. We pre-register ONE seed; the result is what it is. We do NOT run multiple seeds and report the best.
The disease progression model (uniform 6-72h per step) is a simplification of real clinical progression. Real shunt failure progression is highly variable.
honest_disclosure.what_we_are_NOT_claiming: We are NOT claiming these parameters are correct. We are claiming they are FROZEN. The experiment will produce whatever result it produces. The pre-registration ensures the result is interpretable.
